# 3minsto9 ARG & Studio Sources
> Curated source listing for Google Gemini Notebook, NotebookLM, and AI context indexers.

- [Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)](https://3minsto9.co.uk/studio-faq): Comprehensive studio FAQ covering gameplay, puzzles, shipping, and ARG lore. (Raw Fallback: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/3minsto9/329-Website/main/public/studio-faq.html)
- [Studio Press Kit & Media Assets](https://3minsto9.co.uk/studio-press-kit): Official press kit, studio history, media contact details, and brand overview. (Raw Fallback: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/3minsto9/329-Website/main/public/studio-press-kit.html)
- [Studio Contact & Inquiries](https://3minsto9.co.uk/studio-contact-us): Official contact portal for studio inquiries, media, and collaboration. (Raw Fallback: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/3minsto9/329-Website/main/public/studio-contact-us.html)
- [Design Philosophy & Puzzles Explained](https://3minsto9.co.uk/studio-puzzles-explained): In-depth guide explaining puzzle design, ARG mechanics, and transmedia storytelling. (Raw Fallback: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/3minsto9/329-Website/main/public/studio-puzzles-explained.html)
- [Studio Team & Core Members](https://3minsto9.co.uk/studio-team): Profiles and key roles of the 3minsto9 development team. (Raw Fallback: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/3minsto9/329-Website/main/public/studio-team.html)
- [Business Privacy Policy](https://3minsto9.co.uk/business-privacy-policy): Official privacy policy for 3minsto9 Operations. (Raw Fallback: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/3minsto9/329-Website/main/public/business-privacy-policy.html)
